title: Coherent finite scalar restriction for sheafified and derived open extension
statement:
For finite commutative rings $A,B,C$ and homomorphisms $\varphi:A\to B$, $\psi:B\to C$, put $\chi=\psi\varphi$. For each scheme $T$ use constant ring sheaves on its small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Write $r_{\varphi,T}$ for restriction of module-sheaf scalars [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars] and for its exact termwise functor on the unbounded derived categories. Write $\rho_T:r_{\varphi,T}r_{\psi,T}\xrightarrow{\sim}r_{\chi,T}$ for the canonical identification: on underlying abelian sheaves it is the identity and the two actions are $a m=\psi_T(\varphi_T(a))m$; on derived categories it is its termwise localization [lem-weil-pbc-exact-functor-derived-factorization].

Let $j:U\hookrightarrow Z$ be an open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion]. For $R=A,B,C$, let $J_R=j_!^R$ be sheafified extension by zero [def-weil-extension-by-zero], which is exact [lem-weil-extension-by-zero-exact]; $J_R$ also denotes its termwise localization. There is a natural isomorphism of module-sheaf functors
$$e_\varphi:J_A r_{\varphi,U}\xrightarrow{\sim}r_{\varphi,Z}J_B,$$
uniquely characterized by inducing the identity on the defining extension-by-zero presheaves before sheafification. It induces a natural isomorphism with the same endpoints on all of $D(U_{\mathrm{proet}},B)$. For every $C$-module sheaf, every complex thereof and every $K\in D(U_{\mathrm{proet}},C)$, respectively, these specified comparisons satisfy
$$e_{\chi,K}\circ J_A(\rho_{U,K})=\rho_{Z,J_CK}\circ r_{\varphi,Z}(e_{\psi,K})\circ e_{\varphi,r_{\psi,U}K}.$$
For an identity coefficient map the comparison is the identity under the canonical identifications. No quasi-compactness of $j$, flatness of coefficient maps, boundedness or constructibility assumption is imposed.
